name: Forest
text: The gentle start. Ponds, berry bushes, plenty of stone, and fireflies after dark.

name: Jungle
text: Hidden snares and sinkholes, vines that grab, poison, and flash floods.

name: Desert
text: No water but what you tap from cacti. Sandstorms, dust devils, and mirages that might be worth sending a scout to. Or might not.

name: Tundra
text: Nights cold enough to hurt anyone left outside, blizzards, thin ice, and the aurora overhead.
